description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the DU manager in a 5G network software stack, including event handling, configuration, metrics aggregation, and control of the DU MAC layer.

classes.name: du_manager_mac_event_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling external MAC events such as UL CCCH messages and C-RNTI CE detection.

classes.name: du_manager_mac_metric_aggregator
classes.description: Interface for aggregating MAC layer metrics reports.

classes.name: du_manager_configurator
classes.description: Interface for managing DU configuration, including UE context management and asynchronous tasks.

classes.name: du_manager_interface_query
classes.description: Interface for querying DU manager state, such as number of UEs.

classes.name: du_manager_time_mapper_accessor
classes.description: Interface for accessing the DU MAC time-slot mapper.

classes.name: du_manager_controller
classes.description: Interface for starting and stopping the DU manager.

classes.name: du_manager_interface
classes.description: Main interface combining all DU manager functionalities, including event handling, configuration, metrics, and control.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedule an asynchronous task in DU-wide scope.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedule an asynchronous task specific to a UE.

methods.name: handle_f1_reset_request
methods.description: Handle F1 reset request for UEs.

methods.name: handle_cu_context_update_request
methods.description: Handle context update request from CU.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Deactivate DRB activity for a UE.

methods.name: get_subframe_time_mapper
methods.description: Access the DU MAC subframe time mapper.
